desc: Implement primary value-bucket sqrt solution: read input, assign value buckets by sorting all 2N occurrences, build per-bucket A/B element lists sorted by index.
Build global flat 64-bit same-bucket prefix matrices for all value buckets that contain both A and B elements and are not constant-valued; store offsets and widths for O(1) lookup by bucket counts.
Build B prefix bucket count/sum tables at index-block boundaries (block size about 250) and prefix sums of B for total B sum queries.

Process queries sorted by X: maintain A bucket counts/sums incrementally, construct B bucket counts/sums from base table plus remainder, compute cross-bucket answer plus same-bucket matrix lookup, store answers in original order.
Run sample tests; debug cross-bucket formula, bucket ordering, and matrix indexing if needed.
If performance or memory is insufficient, tune VAL_BUCKET/IDX_BLOCK constants and optimize inner loops; if the approach still fails, switch to the fallback A-block sqrt + Fenwick plan.
